name: Mighty Throw (Combat)
body:
You demonstrate the tremendous strength you wield when attacking an enemy with a thrown weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Deadly Aim, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You may apply Deadly Aim and Power Attack when using a thrown weapon. The penalties to attack and the bonus damage stack.

Normal: Power Attack can only be used as part of a melee attack.
